subject: SmallVault CAIQ request — residency, KMS, tenant isolation
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@smallvault.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@smallvault.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SmallVault CAIQ: residency/KMS/tenant isolation evidence request

Hi Marissa,

We are kicking off our vendor assurance for the SmallVault platform and need Redwood's CAIQ/CSA pack focused on a narrow set of controls for the initial intake. Specifically we need:

- CAIQ answers and control mapping for: data residency, encryption key management (KMS/HSM integration), tenant isolation and logical separation, and audit/log retention for runtime inference telemetry.
- For each control, please indicate the control owner (team/person), one representative evidence artifact (e.g., diagram, log sample, KMS rotation screenshot), and the delivery format.
- A short write-up (1 paragraph) for any controls where the implementation differs between Hosted vs Private deployments.

Attached is our CAIQ worksheet with the controls we care about highlighted (SmallVault_CAIQ_questions_20280521.xlsx). We are aiming for a 5 business day turn-around for the initial package. Can you confirm owners and whether you can provide a redacted log sample?

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Head of Security — SmallVault
alice.monroe@smallvault.com

--
File attachments: SmallVault_CAIQ_questions_20280521.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@smallvault.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SmallVault CAIQ: residency/KMS/tenant isolation evidence request

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list and the workbook. We can take this on. Quick confirmation: we'll provide an annotated CAIQ answers spreadsheet and an evidence bundle with a redacted runtime log sample and screenshots for KMS rotation metadata for Private deployments.

Planned owners and next steps (high level):
- Control mapping & CAIQ answers: Marissa (me) + Connor will draft initial annotations and mark any scope variance for Hosted vs Private.
- Runtime telemetry log sample (redacted): Connor (platform ops) will produce a 24-hour sample and apply our redaction checklist.
- KMS/HSM screenshots and key rotation notes: Kim (security/compliance) will collect artifacts and confirm any export restrictions.
- Package assembly and transfer instructions (SFTP/Drive/DocuSign flow): I'll assemble and add evidence-transfer-instructions.pdf with access notes.

I've attached the initial draft (redwood_caiq_answers_v0.1.xlsx) and flagged items that need owner confirmation. We should be able to get the first draft to you within 3 business days; final, complete package by EOD 2028-05-24 if that meets your window.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.coole@redwoodinference.com

--
File attachments: redwood_caiq_answers_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), evidence-transfer-instructions.pdf (pdf)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwoodinference.com>, Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SmallVault CAIQ: residency/KMS/tenant isolation evidence request

Marissa / Kim — adding operational details and timelines below. I've pulled a sample and a short checklist for ops to follow.

Planned artifacts and owners (more granular):
- infra/network diagram (shows VPC boundaries, region pins) — owner: Platform Architecture (assigned: Connor) — artifact: infra_vpc_region_map_v2.pdf
- runtime log sample (redacted token hashes, IPs) — owner: Platform Ops (assigned: Priya) — artifact: runtime_log_sample_redwood_ops.txt (24h slice)
- KMS rotation metadata (rotation events and policy) — owner: Security Engineering (assigned: Kim) — artifact: kms_rotation_audit_202804.pdf
- Tenant isolation narrative (how we enforce logical separation, egress rules) — owner: Product (Connor) — artifact: tenant_isolation_narrative.docx

Ops notes for the log sample: use the log-sanitizer v2 pipeline; redact any user-provided content and truncate long payloads; include header with time range and sampling fraction. I will open JIRA-SUP-4522 for the redaction task and assign to Platform Ops.

ETA: I can produce the log sample and infra diagram by 2028-05-23 COB. Kim, can you confirm whether KMS artifacts include any raw key identifiers that need redaction before sharing?

Connor O'Brien
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

--
File attachments: runtime_log_sample_redwood_ops.txt (text)
From: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SmallVault CAIQ: residency/KMS/tenant isolation evidence request

Thanks — quick legal/compliance notes:

- KMS artifacts: we will not share raw key material or full key identifiers. We can provide rotation event logs, policy screenshots, and HSM attestation references. Please ensure all key IDs are masked (format: ****-xxxx).
- Redaction: follow the evidence redaction checklist (sensitive fields to remove: customer PII, full IP addresses, tokens, internal admin usernames). Soojin, please double-check the runtime_log_sample_redwood_ops.txt once Connor has sanitized it.
- Attestation: SmallVault asked about an attestation flow — if SmallVault requires an attested signature, we will prepare a short attest cover letter and route through DocuSign. That will add 1 business day.

If everyone can get their artifacts to me by EOD 2028-05-23 I will assemble the bundle and send to Alice with the cover letter and a DocuSign link for any required signature.

Kim Park
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

--
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@smallvault.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@smallvault.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SmallVault CAIQ: residency/KMS/tenant isolation evidence request

Thanks, Marissa / team — that plan works. A couple of clarifications before you assemble the bundle:

1) Please include a short column in the annotated CAIQ that says whether the artifact is applicable to Hosted, Dedicated, Private or All. That helps our internal reviewers.
2) For the runtime log sample: redacted is fine; we prefer header-level metadata (timestamps, event types) and one example full request/response pair with sensitive fields masked.
3) If you plan to use DocuSign, please send the link to our security mailbox and I'll route for signature.

If you can get the initial package to us by EOD 2028-05-24 that meets our intake window. Thank you all — look forward to the bundle.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Head of Security — SmallVault
